By using this website, you confirm that all information provided when placing an order is accurate, complete, and truthful.

Prices may change at any time without prior notice.
The price applicable to an order is the price displayed when the customer completes the checkout process.
Shipping fees, service fees, or other additional charges, if applicable, may be charged to the customer and will be shown during checkout.

sections.title: Orders
paragraphs: Customers are responsible for ensuring that all order information, including their name, shipping address, phone number, product, variant, and quantity, is entered correctly.
An order is considered successfully placed once the customer receives an order confirmation from ARÔME HOUSE.

ARÔME HOUSE reserves the right to reject or cancel an order in cases such as pricing or product information errors, unavailable stock, suspected unusual transactions, or other circumstances deemed necessary.
If an order is canceled by ARÔME HOUSE after payment has been made, the customer's payment will be refunded according to the applicable refund method and procedure.

Delays caused by the shipping provider will be handled according to the relevant shipping provider's procedures and policies.
Customers are responsible for ensuring that the shipping address provided is correct and complete.
If a delivery issue is caused by incorrect or incomplete information provided by the customer, additional shipping costs for reshipment may be charged to the customer.

sections.title: Order Inspection
paragraphs: Customers are encouraged to check the condition of their package as soon as it is received.
If the package is damaged, missing items, or contains an incorrect product, customers should contact ARÔME HOUSE as soon as possible.
To help with the inspection process, customers may be asked to provide photos or videos of the package and product as evidence.
Each report will be reviewed first before the ARÔME HOUSE determines the appropriate solution.

Products received in damaged condition or that do not match the order may be reported to ARÔME HOUSE for review and resolution.
ARÔME HOUSE reserves the right to reject a return or exchange request if it does not meet the applicable requirements.

sections.title: Perfume Products & Safe Use
paragraphs: Perfume products are intended for external use only and must not be consumed.
Customers are advised to read the product information and check the ingredients before using the perfume.
Avoid contact with the eyes and sensitive areas, and do not apply the product to irritated or injured skin.
If any unwanted reaction occurs after use, discontinue use and, if necessary, consult a medical professional.
Customers are responsible for using the product as directed and taking their individual circumstances into consideration.
